stem: Which of the following equations has the solutions \(x = 2 + \sqrt{7}\) and \(x = 2 - \sqrt{7}\)?
solution: Solutions of the form \(2 \pm \sqrt{7}\) come from \((x - 2)^{2} = 7\).
Check with the sum and product of the solutions: sum \(4\), product \(4 - 7 = -3\), matching \(x^{2} - 4x - 3\).

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the result of a sign slip when expanding \((x - 2)^{2}\); its solutions are \(-2 \pm \sqrt{7}\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the result of writing \((x - 2)^{2} + 7 = 0\) instead of \((x - 2)^{2} - 7 = 0\); this equation has no real solutions.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the result of dropping the \(+4\) when expanding \((x - 2)^{2} = 7\); its solutions are \(2 \pm \sqrt{11}\).

verify:
x = symbols('x')
p = expand((x - (2 + sqrt(7)))*(x - (2 - sqrt(7))))
assert p == x**2 - 4*x - 3
lhs = {k: value(v.split('=')[0]) for k, v in choices.items()}
assert expand(lhs[answer] - p) == 0
assert all(expand(lhs[k] - p) != 0 for k in choices if k != answer)
